speaker: margery_pell
text: They went out quiet. I never knew a comedy send them out quiet. They'll come again to see if it does it twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The boxes, Margery. Before we are proud of the quiet, I want the sum.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Seven pound, eleven shillings. Gallery and yard. I am not guessing the rest. Abel has the same figure, or he has a quarrel with me.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I have the same figure. Seven pound eleven. And I have the other figure, which is not money. Eleven. I ticked every one of Master Kemp's as he said it. The margin says eleven.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Eleven, and I will own each of them. You heard the yard. They paid their penny for more than the book, and the book survived it. You may look sour, Abel. The ticks are honest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book has eleven. I am not going to decorate the number. You added them. He ticked them. That is the whole sentence.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou hadst the quiet at the end, which I did not plan and will not apologise for. I rode Berowne until the black came on, and then I stopped riding. Thomas stopped the play twice before that, and they loved him for the stops.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Twice, and both times because the word was too large for a first hearing. They lived. I am not sorry. Armado can bear a silence better than a muddle.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Arthur and I sent the Muscovites back. The beards were false and we let the yard know it. Sincler came in black, and the laugh went out like a candle. Sir, in the last scene I did not rush the answer. The Princess governed it. I only stood in her gown and waited.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two torches, and the yard gone blue. The Inns were in it, term or no term. I went on first in a paper crown and old velvet, and I did not improve the first line. I am glad of the quiet. I am not going to explain it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Do not explain it. A quiet exit is a fact. Seven pound eleven is the other fact. If they come again, I shall know them by the stair, and I shall tell you whether they are the same quiet or a new one.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Let them come again. Eleven lines did not sink your ending, Master Shakespeare. You may thank me on a day you are less pale. Today I will take the ticks and a cup.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The ticks are in ink. I will read the margin when we reckon, and it will say eleven, not a song and not a speech about eleven. Master Will, your entrances held. I prompted nothing from a foul paper.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wert Navarre, and thou wert not ashamed of paper. I was proud of the rhymes and I am not going to say a finer thing than that in a tiring-parlour that smells of torches.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The gown did not catch. I could turn. Sam was left of me when he sang, and he found the nail after one wrong step. I did not look for him twice.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The messenger was the cold in it. After my two stops, his was the stop that mattered. Sincler did not ask for a larger kingdom. I am not jealous of a half-line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. The sum is seven pound eleven. The lines are eleven. The exit was quiet. I am going home before supper. Do not bring me a better account of it on the way.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go when thou art ready. I am not walking the figures home with thee.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The sleeves stayed down. I am saying it once, so the book does not have to guess.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Twice was enough stopping for one afternoon. I am not offering a third.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I will take the ticks, and I will not wait to be thanked. You have already said you will not.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The stair is clear. I counted the last of them out. I am not inventing a straggler to make the quiet more interesting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the stair is clear, and the sum is the sum. I have it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I have no better account. I have the boxes, and I have what I said. They went out quiet. That is enough for a Thursday, and it is more than I expected of a new one.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I shall sit on the book until the parlour wants it. Eleven is written. I am not writing twelve to round it. Go home, Master Will. The crown is paper again, on the stool, and it can stay there.
